title: Multifunctional N-substituted 2-pyridylbenzothiazole derivatives: singlet oxygen generation, protein binding, and photoactivated anticancer and antibacterial activities
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,44649-44667
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06375B, Paper
Open Access

Hanan A. Mohamed, Ayman A. Abdel-Shafi, Hideyuki Miyatake, Mohamed E. El-Khouly, Amr A. Nassrallah
Four N-substituted 2-pyridylbenzothiazoles were studied for their optical properties, BSA binding, and therapeutic potential, including antibacterial activity under blue light and photo-cytotoxicity against cancer cells for light therapy application.
